column1: My team surprised me with a small celebration after the presentation.
I keep thinking about the goodbye at the train station.
That handmade note made me feel deeply appreciated.
I am furious that someone erased the work we had saved.
The footsteps behind me on the empty street made me nervous.
I cannot believe the old bookstore is reopening tomorrow!
After weeks of practice, I finally feel calm about the recital.
I miss having long conversations with my cousin on Sundays.
